name: @cytask/desktop
description: Client desktop sécurisé pour les serveurs CyTask auto-hébergés
author: CyberAlien

scripts.check: node --check main.cjs && node --check preload.cjs && node --check renderer/selector.js
scripts.dist:win: npm run server:win && electron-builder --win portable nsis
scripts.dist:linux: npm run server:linux && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb
scripts.dist:mac: npm run server:mac && electron-builder --mac dmg zip
